business_scope.primary_industry_name: Authorized Economic Operator (AEO) Certification and Security Auditing

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (Unitary National System, Continental Napoleonic Tradition)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: United States-Colombia Trade Promotion Agreement (in force 2012)
Colombia-European Union and Peru/Ecuador Trade Agreement (in force 2013)
Pacific Alliance Framework Agreement (Alianza del Pacífico)
Andean Community Decision 578 (Investment Protection, Colombia, Peru, Ecuador, Bolivia)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 526 de 1999 (as amended by Ley 1121 de 2006), Ley 1762 de 2015, Decreto 020 de 2022 (UBO reporting to UIAF), Circular Jurídica No. 100-000318 de 2020 (SIC AML/CFT), Resolución UIAF 011 de 2022 on Politically Exposed Persons, and the Registro de Beneficiarios Finales (RBF) regime administered by the Superintendencia de Sociedades.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified extract of foreign parent company corporate records or constitutional documents
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent corporate registry or notary in the jurisdiction of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Colombia has been a Contracting State since 2000)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Joint notarized and/or certified passport and identity document copies of all shareholders, directors and final beneficial owners
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Colombian Notary for domestic documents; Colombian Consulate or foreign notary for documents executed abroad

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter and sworn source-of-funds statement for the investment capital
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing licensed financial institution or independent certified accountant
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille when issued by a foreign bank; domestic notarization when issued by a Colombian bank

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Foreign corporate good standing certificate of any corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate registry or competent administrative authority in the shareholder's home jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: PEP / sanctions screening and sworn compliance declaration form
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Law firm or compliance consultant, attested before a Colombian notary
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Domestic notarization; consular verification required only if executed abroad by foreign parties

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors and authorized representatives against UIAF national threat lists, DIAN tax-haven list, UN Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List, OFAC SDN List, EU consolidated sanctions list, and the Colombian Superintendencia de Sociedades interdict list. Enhanced due diligence is required under Resolución UIAF 011 de 2022 for politically exposed persons, high-risk jurisdictions, and transactions involving requesters under the FATF recommendations.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES) together with the authorized Cámara de Comercio online platform (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá virtual portal)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be submitted in Spanish or transliterated into Spanish/Latin alphabet in conformance with the official rules of the Real Academia Española. The name must be distinguishable in the RUES database from all existing registered names and may only include characters approved for the Spanish registry system; foreign-language names are permissible only when a corresponding registered trademark or inherent transliteration rationale is provided.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant or its legal representative must file a recurso de reposición with the competent Chamber of Commerce within 10 business days of the notification, stating the legal grounds and correcting the prohibited token or similarity conflict. If the Chamber maintains the rejection, the applicant may file an administrative appeal (recurso de apelación) with the Superintendencia de Sociedades within 10 business days thereafter, under the Colombian Administrative Procedure Code (Ley 1437 de 2011). Concurrently, a new name reservation for an alternative distinct name is recommended to preserve the incorporation timeline.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual offices are generally accepted for preliminary SAS registration if a physical correspondence address and a registered domiciliary agent are declared in the national jurisdiction. However, for an ISIC 7020 AEO certification and supply-chain auditing operation, the customs authority (DIAN) will require a fixed, verifiable operational address with actual document retention and audit capabilities; virtual-only arrangements are not acceptable at the AEO final certification stage.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Moderate-to-high; approximately 65% probability of unannounced or scheduled physical inspection within the first twelve months of a customs AEO application, given the security and audit requirements imposed by DIAN and the World Customs Organization SAFE Framework.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name reservation and preliminary name clearance search
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff set by the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarized SAS execution before a public notary
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory notarial fee schedule of the Superintendencia de Notariado y Registro

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Chamber of Commerce registration and inscription fees
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory registry tariff under Decreto 19 de 2012 and applicable municipal contribution

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO, PEP and sanctions screening and compliance file preparation
Hague apostille, certified Spanish translation and consular legalization of foreign corporate and ID documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministerio de Relaciones Exteriores and sworn public translator
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory consular tariff and certified translation market benchmark

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Pre-incorporation legal and tax advisory fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark (fixed fee or hourly professional rate)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered office arrangement and registered agent service, first year
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Commercial real estate provider / authorized nominee services

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada regime) arts. 4, 5, 21, 25 and 41; Código de Comercio arts. 110, 354 and 421; Decreto Único Reglamentario 1074 de 2015 (Title 4, Mercantile Registry).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social operating the Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES), under oversight of the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución (private constitutional document) accompanied by the Formulario Único de Registro Empresarial (RUES form); a public deed (Escritura Pública) is required only where real property is contributed to capital.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: None. Ley 1258 de 2008 (art. 5) eliminates minimum capital for S.A.S. companies; subscribed capital must be paid in full within two years unless a shorter by-law term is stipulated; no escrow account or capital deposit is a precondition of incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION OF [COMPANY NAME] S.A.S. At a lawful shareholders' meeting held on this date in Bogotá D.C., the following resolutions were unanimously adopted: (1) Ratification of the Documento Privado de Constitución of [COMPANY NAME] S.A.S., acknowledging the subscription and full payment of the issued share capital. (2) Fixing the registered office at [ADDRESS], Bogotá D.C., and authorizing the Legal Representative to register the address with the Cámara de Comercio and DIAN. (3) Appointment of [NAME] as Legal Representative (Representante Legal) and [NAME] as Alterno, vested with full powers under Ley 1258 de 2008, including opening corporate bank accounts and executing management consultancy and AEO audit contracts. (4) Filing of the registration and tax applications.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company name availability and homonym pre-check
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES) - online window of the Cámara de Comercio
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name consultation (consulta de homonimia) through the RUES portal to verify that the proposed corporate name is not identical or confusingly similar to an existing Colombian company or registered trademark. Secure the name reservation for 30 calendar days and confirm the corporate name ends with the mandatory 'S.A.S.' suffix.
required_dossiers: Identification documents of each shareholder (passport or cédula)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is unavailable or flagged as confusingly similar, file a variation adding a distinguishing element (e.g., geographic descriptor or industry term) and resubmit within the 30-day reservation window.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of the Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Shareholders executing a private document; notary only if real estate is contributed to capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft and sign the Documento Privado de Constitución in Spanish, covering corporate name, registered office, corporate purpose (management consulting, AEO/supply-chain security auditing), duration, authorized/subscribed/paid capital, governing bodies (Asamblea de Accionistas and Legal Representative), and audit clause. Signatures may be certified privately; notarization (Escritura Pública) is required only for in-kind real property contributions.
required_dossiers: Shareholders' signatures or notarized power of attorney for remote execution
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the chamber requires notarization due to real-estate in-kind contributions, execute an Escritura Pública before a Colombian notary and attach the deed to the filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration with the Mercantile Registry (Matrícula Mercantil)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá) via RUES
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the executed Documento Privado de Constitución together with the Formulario Único de Registro Empresarial and pay the registration rights fee (derechos de inscripción). Using the 'S.A.S. en línea' one-stop digital channel, the chamber issues the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal, which constitutes conclusive evidence of the S.A.S.'s legal existence and representation.
required_dossiers: Legal representative's acceptance statement (manifestación de aceptación)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry detects formal defects, file an amendment (reforma) within 30 calendar days; an outright denial may be challenged by recurso de reposición (administrative appeal) within 10 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax registration and issuance of NIT and RUT
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) - virtual office and RUES integration
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the pre-RUT through the RUES/DIAN integrated portal to obtain the NIT (tax ID number) and the RUT (tax registry), registering economic activity code 7020 (management consultancy activities) and ancillary code 7490 (business support). The RUT also activates the company as an authorized electronic-invoicing issuer (facturador electrónico).
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
Identification document of the legal representative
Registered office address, telephone and email
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RUT is rejected for an address or activity mismatch, correct the declared data and resubmit; for persistent errors, attend a DIAN TA (technical assistance) window for manual validation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate bank account and electronic invoicing activation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Colombian financial institutions (bank) and DIAN electronic invoicing platform
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a COP-denominated corporate checking or savings account with a Colombian bank, deposit any paid-in capital, and complete know-your-customer verification. Activate electronic invoicing through DIAN habilitación (Resolución 000165 de 2023) and configure the e-invoicing software with the RUT fiscal data.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
Lease agreement or proof of registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requires additional evidence of physical presence, provide the municipal zoning certificate, executed lease agreement, or utility bill in the company's name; escalate to a second bank if the first application is declined.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal zoning permit, fire safety certificate, and occupational risk registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Secretaría Distrital de Planeación / Alcaldía Local; Cuerpo de Bomberos; Administradora de Riesgos Laborales (ARL)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for the Concepto de Uso del Suelo authorizing professional office use of the premises. Schedule a fire-safety inspection with the Cuerpo de Bomberos and obtain the certificate. For any employees, register the company with an ARL and implement the minimum SG-SST occupational safety program under Resolución 0312 de 2019.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the zoning concept is denied for a non-compatible residential location, request a 'uso compatible' conditional permit or relocate the office to a commercial zoning area; correct fire-safety defects noted by the Bomberos and request re-inspection within 15 days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable to ISIC 7020 consulting/audit services; physical-office permitting falls under Secretaría Distrital de Planeación (zoning), Cuerpo de Bomberos (fire safety), and ARL/Ministerio del Trabajo (occupational risk).
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No industrial operating permit required; operational clearances comprise the Matrícula Mercantil (already issued) and the Concepto de Uso del Suelo for the registered office.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - office-based professional consulting services do not appear in the EIA trigger list of Decreto 1076 de 2015 (implementing Ley 99 de 1993); no environmental license, separate discharge permit or environmental registration is required for the consultancy's operational footprint. If the company later operates a data center or warehousing facility over 2,000 m², an environmental registration (registro de generador de residuos) may apply.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable to the audit service itself; compliance obligations cover domestic wastewater discharge to municipal sewers under Decreto 1076 de 2015 (Title 2.2.3.3.4), consumable e-waste disposal under Resolución 1573 de 2011, and no VOC or combustion emissions from industrial processes on the office premises.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire-safety certificate issued by the Cuerpo de Bomberos verifying egress, extinguishers and signage; structural compliance with NSR-10 (Norma Sismo Resistente) certified by a licensed engineer for the office building; occupational clearance via worker registration with an ARL and implementation of the minimum SG-SST standards under Resolución 0312 de 2019.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) - Colombia's national tax and customs authority. Official portal: www.dian.gov.co; primary digital channels: MUISCA (tax ID, RUT, returns, payments), the Facturación Electrónica dashboard (electronic invoicing), and VUCE/SIGLO XXI (customs and foreign-trade clearance).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: Execute incorporation documents of the S.A.S. and register them in the Cámara de Comercio of the head-office city to obtain the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal. Step 2: Enroll in DIAN's Registro Único Tributario (RUT) online through MUISCA, obtaining the NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria), selecting 'Responsable del IVA - Régimen Común' and the applicable customs status (exportador/importador/AEO) for the ISIC 7020 scope. Step 3: Obtain the digital certificate (firma electrónica) of the legal representative for electronic filing and e-invoicing. Step 4: Register foreign shareholders' identities and ultimate beneficial owners where the local AML framework so requires. A 100% non-resident owner may hold and govern the S.A.S., but the Colombian-resident S.A.S. itself is the taxpayer and must procure its own NIT/RUT before making any taxable supply in Colombia.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation - The S.A.S. is a distinct legal person and a Colombian tax resident, subject to entity-level corporate income tax at the general 35% rate (2025) and liable for IVA, ICA (municipal industry and commerce tax), and complementary levies; its shareholders are taxed only upon dividend distributions, with withholding at source for non-resident shareholders. No pass-through or fiscal-transparency election exists; the S.A.S. cannot flow its tax attributes through to foreign owners.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Colombia has no check-the-box regime; legal-form classification is imposed by law. Elective mechanisms relevant to an S.A.S.: (i) Régimen Simple de Tributación (RSRT/SIMPLE), a combined income and gross-receipts tax election for S.A.S. with prior-year gross income not exceeding 3,500 UVT (approx. COP 174.3 million in 2025, UVT = COP 49,799); (ii) a group may petition DIAN for autorización de consolidación fiscal (tax consolidation) of controlled subsidiaries; (iii) hybrid mismatch limitation rules (Law 2010 of 2019) restrict deductions or impose entity-classification recharacterization for certain hybrid instruments and entities without granting an elective opt-in; and (iv) non-resident owners may characterize the S.A.S. as a service provider or lessee for withholding purposes under DIAN guidance. AEO certification, being a customs compliance status, does not of itself alter any tax election.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: IVA - Impuesto sobre las Ventas (Colombian Value Added Tax), harmonized with the DIAN fiscal-invoicing framework
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: There is no de minimis turnover threshold for legal entities: any S.A.S. performing habitual taxable sales or services must register as an IVA-responsible common-regime taxpayer from its first taxable supply. Natural persons can use the simplified IVA regime only while prior-year gross income is at or below 3,500 UVT (2025: approx. COP 174.3 million). Export-oriented S.A.S. businesses must register even if all sales are zero-rated, and digital-service suppliers supplying Colombian B2B or B2C services must register under the same IVA rules.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Since 2023-2024 (Resolución DIAN 000165 of 2023 and amendments), the FEV (Factura Electrónica de Venta) is mandatory for nearly all taxpayers. The invoice must be generated in XML/UBL 2.1 through DIAN-authorized software providers or DIAN's free web platform, transmitted to DIAN in near-real time, and validated to obtain a CUNE (Consecutivo Único de Numeración Electrónica), the fiscal digital stamp, before it may be delivered to the buyer. Buyers must emit the 'Recibo de Bien o Servicio' acceptance event. Export invoices use the dedicated Factura Electrónica de Exportación module and must be reconciled with the customs export data so that the 0% IVA regime is accepted; any mismatch triggers customs block and denial of VAT refunds.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Under Article 481 E.T., exports of tangible goods are zero-rated (0% IVA) when physically shipped under a valid Declaración de Exportación (DEX) and when the exporter collects the consideration in convertible currency through the Colombian foreign-exchange market or an authorized offset. Export-linked services (e.g., AEO and supply-chain security audits performed for non-resident clients), and offshore services in general, qualify as 'servicios exportados' at 0% when the beneficiary is a non-resident without Colombian domicile, the service is not used or exploited in Colombia, and the transaction is paid from abroad. The S.A.S. must evidence each service's cross-border destination and maintain a technical audit file (contract, scope report, counterparty identification) ready for DIAN inspection. Inward VAT on export-related inputs may be deducted and claimed as a refund (saldo a favor) through bimonthly IVA declarations.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Declaración de Exportación - DEX) submitted through the DIAN/VUCE channel with the official validation number
Bill of Lading (ocean) or Air Waybill (air) issued by the carrier, with data consistent with the DEX
Electronic export invoice (Factura Electrónica de Exportación) with CUNE and 0% IVA statement
Commercial invoice and packing list in the language of the contract
Certificate of origin or preferential-origin evidence when a tariff preference is claimed

Inward Remittance Certificate: the foreign-exchange declaration (Declaración de Cambio por Exportaciones) or constancia de canalización certifying that the hard-currency proceeds were settled in Colombia
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN may retroactively revoke the 0% rating where the export document bundle is incomplete or contradictory, the DEX has been cancelled, the buyer and seller are related without a transfer-pricing analysis, or repatriation is late. Consequences include: (i) reclassification of the supply as taxed at 19%, with assessment of the VAT and moratory interest; (ii) the 'sanción por inexactitud' of 200% of the additional assessment (or of the overclaimed balance) under Article 647 E.T., aggravated by up to 300% in serious fraud cases; (iii) suspension or loss of AEO and exporter status; (iv) criminal prosecution for customs fraud under Law 1762 of 2015 with imprisonment of up to 8 years; and (v) extension of DIAN's statutory assessment window from 5 to 10 years for unreported or fraudulent claims, enabling full retrospective clawback of refunded balances.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil – annual renewal of commercial registration and company data through Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio, with oversight by the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: January 1 – March 31 of each year; renewal must be completed by March 31 regardless of registration anniversary
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Extemporaneous surcharge of up to 15% of the renewal tariff applied after March 31; failure to renew for three months triggers cancellation of the commercial registration and loss of merchant status; continuing unregistered activity exposes the SAS and its legal representative to fines and banking restrictions

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Asamblea General Ordinaria – annual shareholders' meeting for approval of prior-year financial statements, profit allocation, and legal-representative discharge; minutes entered in the corporate minute book
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Internal corporate body of the Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada; no direct government filing unless judicial convening is required
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: By March 31 of each year within the first quarter, as required by Law 222 of 1995 and Law 1258 of 2008
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Shareholders may seek judicial calling of the assembly; delay blocks the deposit of financial statements with the Cámara de Comercio and exposes the legal representative to civil liability for losses and to corporate-dissolution risk where accumulated losses are not addressed

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Estados Financieros de Fin de Ejercicio – deposit of general-purpose financial statements (balance sheet, income statement, changes in equity, cash flows, notes, legal certifications, and statutory auditor's report when applicable)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio and, indirectly, the Superintendencia de Sociedades
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Same deadline as the annual shareholders' meeting: by March 31 of each year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Cámara de Comercio may reject or surcharge the annual commercial renewal; the Superintendencia de Sociedades may impose fines for repeated non-disclosure and require sworn compliance reports from the legal representative

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Declaración de Renta y Complementarios – annual corporate income tax and complementary returns
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: August 12 – September 12 of the year following the taxable year, allocated by the last two digits of the NIT under the annual DIAN resolution; FY2024 return due in August–September 2025
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalty of 5% of tax due per month or fraction of delay, capped at 100% of tax due under ET Article 641; non-filing triggers omission-of-assets penalties of up to 160% of omitted tax, moratory interest, and potential embargo of bank accounts

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registro de Beneficiarios Finales – annual consolidated UBO confirmation identifying natural persons directly or indirectly owning, controlling, or benefiting from at least 10% of the entity
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN virtual UBO registry under Resolution 164 of 2021, as amended
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually between mid-January and March 1 per the DIAN calendar; the 2025 cycle closed on March 1; shareholding or control changes during the year must be updated within 30 calendar days of the change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: DIAN fines under ET Articles 651 and 658-1 for omission, inaccuracy, or late updating; potential suspension of RUT transactions and adverse consequences for customs and AEO-related operations

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Información Exógena – annual third-party information return covering shareholders, suppliers, foreign payments, payroll, and customer transactions exceeding DIAN thresholds
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Typically due by June 24 for the prior calendar year; the FY2024 report was due June 24, 2025
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fine of up to 15,000 UVT for non-submission plus a fine of 1% of omitted amounts; erroneous submissions attract additional penalties, and willful misstatement may carry tax-fraud exposure

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: AEO/OEA Annual Maintenance Surveillance – annual update and verification of the Authorized Economic Operator security, internal-control, and supply-chain audit program where the SAS holds OEA certification; authorization validity is five years with annual DIAN supervision
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN – División de Gestión de Comercio Exterior / OEA regime under Decreto 1165 de 2019 and Resolución DIAN 458 de 2019
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary month of certification and upon DIAN scheduling; annual supply-chain audit workpapers and client AEO verification records must be available on demand
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Suspension or revocation of OEA authorization, cancellation of customs facilitations, activation of applicable guarantees, and exclusion from the authorized operator list upon repeated non-compliance

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory Revisor Fiscal (statutory auditor) if prior-year total assets or gross revenues exceed 3,000 SMMLV (approximately COP 4,270,500,000 for 2025), if the entity employs more than 200 workers, or if the SAS is a public-interest, securities-issuing, or regulated-sector entity; otherwise the SAS is exempt from a mandatory independent statutory audit
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as incorporated by Decreto 2420 de 2015: Grupo 1 full IFRS for large and public-interest entities; Grupo 2 NIIF para PYMES (IFRS for SMEs) for the standard SAS; financial statements expressed in COP with tax-basis reconciliations prepared for the DIAN filing

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: DIAN Resolution 164 of 2021 requires every legal entity to confirm its final-beneficiary structure annually, even when no shareholding changes occurred; the consolidated annual update occurs in the January–March 1 window; any transfer or change affecting 10% or more ownership or control must be filed within 30 calendar days of the event; the annual UBO confirmation is a prerequisite for smooth RUT renewal and AEO surveillance
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Shareholders (Libro de Registro de Accionistas) – registered and stamped at the Cámara de Comercio
Minute Book (Libro de Actas de Asamblea; also Junta Directiva minutes if a board exists)
Official accounting records (Libros de Comercio): Diario, Mayor, and Inventarios y Balances, maintained with DIAN/Cámara authorization

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 200–600 per year for registered corporate domicile, virtual office, and legal-correspondence handling by a Colombia-licensed service provider in Bogotá or Medellín
